title: 新手引导与机制说明不足
description: 游戏缺乏有效的教程、文档和机制说明，导致玩家难以理解基本操作、系统机制和任务目标。
evidence: Very little outside of the basic mechanics of how to fly your ship is explained
i didnt know what to do (no tutorial)
There is no actual tutorial to explain anything

evidence_items.quote: Die Grafik wirkt zunächst unübersichtlich und ich hatte ehrlich gesagt keine Ahnung, was ich eigentlich tun soll.
evidence_items.description: 图形界面起初显得混乱，不清楚该做什么
evidence_items.quote_zh: 画面一开始显得杂乱无章，老实说，我完全不知道自己到底该做什么。

evidence_items.quote: Almost and i mean like 60% of game's content is not explained and a lot of key features are straight up left unexplained
evidence_items.description: 约60%的游戏内容没有解释，许多关键功能未说明。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 几乎，我是说大约60%的游戏内容都没有解释，而且很多关键功能干脆就完全没说明。

evidence_items.quote: you will need to spend maybe 20 hours figuring out just the basics of what the f it's telling you, and how the f you do the things
evidence_items.description: UI难懂且缺乏说明，需要约20小时才能理解基本操作
evidence_items.quote_zh: 你可能需要花上大约20个小时才能搞明白它到底在跟你说什么鬼东西，以及你到底该怎么干那些事

evidence_items.quote: Apparently this game has a deep simulation for characters relations, mental needs etcetc, but it was too arcane for me to figure it out, so I just ignored it. As is the norm for the game, it won't tell you anything, you're supposed to figure things out
evidence_items.description: 角色关系、心理需求等模拟系统过于晦涩，游戏不提供说明
evidence_items.quote_zh: 显然这款游戏对角色关系、心理需求等等有着深度模拟，但对我来说太晦涩难懂了，搞不明白，所以我干脆就忽略了。就像这款游戏的惯例一样，它什么都不会告诉你，你得自己去摸索

evidence_items.quote: there is not much help on everything outside the initial tutorial

evidence_items.quote_zh: 除了最初的教学之外，关于其他一切都没有多少帮助

evidence_items.description: 机制说明不清
evidence_items.quote_zh: 机制说明糟糕

evidence_items.quote_zh: 对于一款如此过度复杂的游戏来说，它的说明仍然做得非常糟糕。

evidence_items.quote:
unintuitive and uninformative UI/controls.

不直观且信息不足的UI/操作。

evidence_items.quote:
The game fails to explain the only properly implemented content is the white location diamonds, mentioned only in the patch notes as far as I can find, meaning only two locations have been implemented in the long duration so far, with the medical center in Venus Orbital still having the OKLG dialogue.
This made it nearly impossible for me to figure out if there was a second ship selling location

evidence_items.quote_zh:
游戏没有说明唯一正确实现的内容是白色的地点菱形标记，据我所知只在补丁说明中提到过，这意味着在这么长的时间里只实现了两个地点，而金星轨道上的医疗中心仍然有着OKLG的对话。
这让我几乎不可能弄清楚是否存在第二个卖船的地点
